home.heroTitle: Private personalised tours with a local guide in Rio de Janeiro
home.heroSubtitle: No megaphones, no groups in matching vests. Just me showing you my city the way I'd show a friend.
home.toursSubtitle: Every tour is built around what you want to see. Tell me what you're curious about and we'll plan it together.

howItWorks.step1Body: Send me a WhatsApp. Tell me when you're in Rio, who's coming, and what you'd like to see.
howItWorks.step2Body: I'll suggest what fits your days, your pace and your budget. Nothing is fixed — we shape it around you.
howItWorks.step3Body: I pick you up at your hotel and we go. No rush, no script, no crowd.

tours.title: Tours in Rio de Janeiro
tours.subtitle: Private, personalised, and always with a local.

footer.tagline: Private tours in Rio de Janeiro with a guide who was born here.
